messages:
rachael: quick one — LumenHealth (seed, medtech monitoring) asked if we can extend the usual startup trial. they want 6 months and $15k in credits to run a +embedding store + two-model ensemble for a HIPAA POC. security questionnaire still open, they're asking for private deployment later. any way to approve more than the standard 3 months / $10k?

matt: SE here — what's the expected ingest and qps? we can probably suggest model quantization + cache to drop cost. do they need streaming long-context?

rachael: they said 400k tokens/day peak during simulated workload, mostly short chat + embeddings. want low-latency for alerts. customer says timeline: 6 months POC before pilot.

devon: finance note — standard startup promo: 3 months, up to $10k credits. exceptions require dealdesk sign-off + reviewed subsidies budget. also need a signed CLA/MSA for medical data before private deploy.

kevin-dealdesk: tagging @rachael — we can approve an exception if we get compensating controls. proposed structure:
```
- 6 months total term
- $10k trial credit (no change) + $5k conditional credit escrowed as usage discount
- Customer signs a 6-month minimum committed spend of $3k/month OR prepay $9k to unlock the extra $5k
- Data & security: must sign MSA + SOC2/HIPAA addendum before private deployment
- Redwood reserves right to convert to paid or throttle if abuse/spikes > 2x baseline
```
this keeps subsidy limited and ties extra credit to a small commit.

rachael: ok that seems reasonable. could legal quick-review the MSA + HIPAA addendum? i'll push this structure in the offer and see if they accept prepay vs commit.

legal-jane: I'll review addendum. FYI we need to confirm KMS/HSM approach for keys and data flow diagram before sign.

matt: technical note — for the POC we can provide a lower-cost model variant that preserves quality for alerts and cut baseline cost by ~30%. i'll include perf/cost comparison in the proposal.

devon: one more finance constraint — promotional budget for this quarter is limited. if they pick prepay option we can make exception. if it's pure credit with no commit we need VP sign-off.

kevin-dealdesk: understood. i'll approve conditional exception for prepay path now. VP sign-off required for pure subsidy.

rachael: perfect. i'll present two options to LumenHealth: (A) prepay $9k -> unlock $5k extra credit + 6mo support, or (B) 3mo default $10k trial. I'll loop in @legal-jane and @matt with the customer call tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:

discountbot: auto-note — startup-credit-pool remaining for Q1: $42,100. any dealdesk exception must reference ticket DD-4591.

rachael: creating DD ticket and adding links in the proposal thread. will update once customer responds.

kevin-dealdesk: cheers. once we have signed PO or prepay receipt, we can wire the extra credit into their account and open the private deployment checklist.
